title: the 'do you wish to see all N possibilities (M lines)?' prompt reports a different N/M

observed.fingerprint_label: cell/rowtop/col3 | ref/zsh: do you wish to see all # possibilities (# lines)? | test/zsh: do you wish to see all # possibilities (# lines)?

rows.zsh: zsh: do you wish to see all 802 possibilities (825 lines)?
rows.zshrs: zsh: do you wish to see all 803 possibilities (814 lines)?

observed.notes: One extra match and eleven fewer lines. The counts depend on this host's installed fonts, so the exact numbers are expected to move; what must not change is that the two shells disagree. The harness fingerprint b29792c9a7 masks the digits, which is why it groups the whole family.

variants.note: same symptom from parameter-name completion, confirmed first-hand 2026-08-30, but under its OWN fingerprint e8e0447836 rather than b29792c9a7 — the shape id takes the surrounding context in, so the same wrong count in a different position is a different shape. zsh 'zsh: do you wish to see all 396 possibilities (99 lines)?' vs zshrs '... 400 possibilities (100 lines)?'.

confirmed.note: all three harness files had uncommitted edits when this was confirmed (three agents were editing them concurrently); the sha256 prefixes above pin the exact bytes used.
